title: GUN STAT CARD IN THE BACKPACK
why: His feature 17 of 2026-10-12, better gun stat cards, and his answer 34: the card shows on pickup and in the backpack. This is the backpack half. Point the mouse at a gun in the backpack, or select one with the arrows or the D-pad, and the same card as the pickup shows beside the backpack: UPGRADE, DOWNGRADE or SIDEGRADE against the gun in your hands, then damage, rate, magazine, range and handling with the differences. The item lines under the grid are unchanged, and the Undercroft backpack shows the card too.
now: The backpack now shows a gun stat card for the gun under the mouse or the selected gun.
